method: Human-like semantic readback by assistant of saved responses, no fresh task solving or API inference
scope: 69 responses without explicit final-line label; combine with existing response-only final-line extraction for other531
gold_visibility: Review packet excludes gold, saved prediction and correctness. Prior thread includes some labels; this is not fully blinded independent annotation.
rules: Extract an explicit choice or a declarative conclusion that unambiguously affirms one option / rules out the other.
No need for final A/B if semantic answer is clear.
Do not infer an answer merely from supplied world facts, actions, conditional antecedents, or unfinished target propositions.
Do not solve the benchmark question to fill a missing answer.
Preserve exact supporting quote; undecidable outputs remain null, counted incorrect in end-to-end accuracy.
Explicit final answer overrides earlier reasoning when present.
